This is the reproducible record for the governed 2018–19 holdout cycle.
Season identifiers are labels, not an ordering rule: every valid season other
than the permanent exclusions and `2018-19` is used for training.  The runner
is `run_2018_cycle.R`; it enforces M0 boundary validation before M1 tuning and
M1 boundary validation before M2 tuning.

All private outputs, checkpoints, logs, and replay artifacts are written to the
canonical archive configured by `PAGE_ARTIFACT_ROOT` (on this run:
`/home/yeli/PAGe-bcc-artifacts/asgard-archive-20260812/2018/`).

```bash
PAGE_ARTIFACT_ROOT=/home/yeli/PAGe-bcc-artifacts/asgard-archive-20260812 \
  PAGE_RUN_ID=2018-final \
  Rscript 2018/run_2018_cycle.R \
  > /home/yeli/PAGe-bcc-artifacts/asgard-archive-20260812/2018-final/run.log 2>&1
```

The compact `status.tsv`, stage checkpoints, tuning objects, frozen candidate,
season selection, and run manifest are the authoritative run record.  The
holdout is not used during tuning or fitting and is evaluated only after the
candidate is frozen.
